description.text: Battle Theme Deck: Victini, released on 17 June 2011, a month before the films Victini and the Black Hero: Zekrom and Victini and the White Hero: Reshiram (as their Japanese titles run) opened on 16 July. It gave the Mythical Pokémon Victini its first cards. Its 40 cards, six of them holo, make two half decks: a base of 20 Trainer and Energy cards plus one of two sets of ten Pokémon, the Formation deck around a Fire-type Victini, whose Pokémon join forces for big damage, or the Coin Toss deck around a Psychic-type Victini, which stakes its battles on coin flips. Its deck-building guide gave recipes that mix it with the Black Collection, White Collection and Red Collection expansions.
